items.title: Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 1997
items.q: They put a rerun on that night because Buddy was one of Carson’s favorite people, not just musician.

ctx.x: Yeah, after the show. We taped the show and the show was aired that night, and the next day he dies of a heart attack. And one when Buddy Rich died. We were rehearsing the show and Johnny got word that Buddy died. Bam he canceled the show immediately. They put a rerun on that night because Buddy was one of Carson’s favorite people, not just musician. He was tremendous. I don’t know if you ever caught any of the shows that Buddy did, but he was great at the panel with Johnny. He was just, — oh, slick as they come.
